description:
## Problem

Both ex_dna and reach use Code.string_to_quoted/2 and Code.compile_file/1 for AST parsing. These are code execution vectors if the input is attacker-controlled — arbitrary Elixir code can be injected via the source string.

## Evidence

From reach:
- reach/lib/reach/frontend/elixir.ex: Code.string_to_quoted(source, ...)
- reach/lib/reach/smell/checks/idiom_mismatch.ex: Code.string_to_quoted!()
- reach/lib/reach/project.ex: Code.compile_file(mix_file)
- reach/lib/reach/plugins/live_view/heex/parser.ex: Code.string_to_quoted!()

From ex_dna:
- ex_dna/lib/ex_dna/detection/pipeline.ex: Code.string_to_quoted(source, ...)
- ex_dna/lib/ex_dna/refactor/behaviour_suggestion.ex: Code.string_to_quoted(source, ...)

## Expected Behavior

Code.string_to_quoted, Code.string_to_quoted!, Code.compile_file, Code.compile_string should be flagged as code execution sinks in the Elixir-Code-Execution rule.

## Suggested Fix

Add to rules/elixir-sinks.kdl Elixir-Code-Execution rule:
- sink "Code.string_to_quoted" arg=0
- sink "Code.string_to_quoted!" arg=0
- sink "Code.compile_file" arg=0
- sink "Code.compile_string" arg=0
- sink "Code.eval_quoted" arg=0

Also add :erlang.binary_to_term as a deserialization sink (unsafe deserialization of BEAM terms).
title: Elixir: add Code.string_to_quoted and Code.compile_string as code execution sinks
